data.summary: Results-driven Senior Network Engineer with 7+ years of progressive experience designing, securing, and optimizing enterprise-grade networks across data centers, banking, and government sectors. Deep expertise in routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), advanced switching (VLAN, VXLAN), next-generation firewall management (FortiGate, Palo Alto), and cloud security (Netskope, Cloudflare). Demonstrated success maintaining 99.9% uptime for mission-critical WANs, leading complex network migrations, and delivering scalable, secure infrastructure aligned with business objectives. Currently extending cloud and security expertise with AWS, Terraform, and SASE technologies.

raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven Senior Network Engineer with 7+ years of progressive experience designing, securing, and optimizing enterprise-grade networks across data centers, banking, and government sectors. Deep expertise in routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), advanced switching (VLAN, VXLAN), next-generation firewall management (FortiGate, Palo Alto), and cloud security (Netskope, Cloudflare). Demonstrated success maintaining 99.9% uptime for mission-critical WANs, leading complex network migrations, and delivering scalable, secure infrastructure aligned with business objectives. Currently extending cloud and security expertise with AWS, Terraform, and SASE technologies.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
✦ BGP / OSPF / Static Routing
✦ Palo Alto / FortiGate / Panorama ✦ AWS Cloud Infrastructure
✦ VLAN / VXLAN / STP / EtherChannel
✦ Netskope SASE / CASB
✦ Terraform IaC
✦ IPsec / SSL VPN
✦ Cloudflare (CDN / DDoS / Zero Trust)
✦ Wireshark / Network Troubleshooting
✦ Cisco / Juniper / Huawei Devices ✦ Vulnerability Assessment
✦ JIRA / Incident Management
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Routing Protocols: BGP, OSPF, Static Routing • Switching & Overlay: VLAN, VXLAN, STP/RSTP, EtherChannel • Firewalls & Security: Palo Alto NGFW, FortiGate, Panorama, Web/IP Filtering, IPsec VPN, SSL VPN • SASE / Cloud Security: Netskope (CASB, SWG, ZTNA), Cloudflare (CDN, DDoS Mitigation, Zero Trust Access) • Cloud Platforms: AWS (VPC, Transit Gateway, Security Groups, Direct Connect), eNlight Cloud • • Network Devices: Cisco (IOS/IOS-XE), Juniper (Junos), Huawei • Troubleshooting Tools: Wireshark, Layer 2/3 diagnostics, Performance Optimization, Log Analysis • Security Practices: Vulnerability Assessment, Firewall Policy Management, Network Audits • Monitoring & ITSM: Industry-standard NMS tools, JIRA, Incident & Change Management Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (network provisioning, firewall rule automation, cloud deployments)
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Network Engineer Blackline Systems
July 2025 – Present
Joined as Senior Network Engineer contributing to enterprise network architecture and security strategy. • Leveraging advanced expertise in Palo Alto firewalls, Netskope SASE, Cloudflare, and AWS cloud networking. • Implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform for network automation and deployment pipelines. • Designing and enforcing Zero Trust network access policies across cloud and on-premise environments. • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to align network security posture with business and compliance requirements.
Senior Network Engineer ESDS Software Solutions
October 2021 – June 2025
Managed network operations and security for enterprise WANs serving 100+ clients, maintaining 99.9% uptime across a high-availability data center environment.
Designed and deployed VLAN/VXLAN configurations enabling seamless server connectivity across 50+ nodes, reducing provisioning time by 30%.
Administered FortiGate and Palo Alto next-generation firewalls; authored and enforced security policies including web filtering, IP filtering, and application control.
Configured and managed IPsec VPN tunnels and SSL VPN gateways for secure remote and site-to-site connectivity for government and private sector clients.
Led network assessments and audits to identify vulnerabilities, resulting in measurable improvements to security posture and compliance adherence.
Troubleshot complex Layer 2/3 issues including link failures, packet drops, and link flapping using Wireshark and performance diagnostic tools.
Provided hands-on support for Cisco, Juniper, and Huawei network devices, ensuring optimal performance for data services.
Coordinated with clients and internal teams to resolve critical incidents within SLA, maintaining high client satisfaction.
Network Support Engineer Nexapp Technology Pvt. Ltd.
May 2019 – October 2021
• Served as primary network support contact, diagnosing and resolving LAN/WAN issues and minimizing business-
impacting downtime.
Configured and maintained SSL and IPsec VPN solutions for secure enterprise connectivity across multiple client sites.
Managed Cisco routers and switches, implementing upgrades and proactive maintenance to enhance network

reliability. Implemented structured network change management processes, reducing unplanned outages by improving documentation and runbooks.
Network Engineer Intern zCon Solutions
January 2019 – March 2019
Monitored network infrastructure health and performance, proactively identifying and escalating anomalies. • Created and managed JIRA tickets for incident tracking; supported real-time network monitoring and basic remediation tasks.
